en_US: Zuki: Yes, this is where we welcome
HO-OH.
When the dance we practiced for many
days becomes one with the sound of the
Clear Bell we entrusted to you,
then HO-OH shall come down from the
great arch of the sky once again!
This is all we can do for you...
What you do now is entirely up to you...
That IS indeed HO-OH...
The guardian of the sky around here
from ancient times...
So many have tried and tried, only
to fail...
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your heart and the Clear
Bell in harmony have finally made
it appear...
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, don’t you see?
HO-OH must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.
Wouldn’t you agree...?
You have done a great job.
Say hello to Professor Elm for us.
You have not only made HO-OH appear,
but you have also caught it...
You are so wonderful.
There is nothing more for us to say.
Take good care of yourself in
your journey...
If that is what you believe, we will not
try to convince you otherwise.
Still, if you want to see HO-OH once
more, perhaps you can come back here
after everything has been settled...
I think when you turn your back to it,
HO-OH will not come back for
some time...

can come back here after everything
